project: Paper 2 / Studies 3, 4, 6 / new independent integrated rehearsal
hypothesis: Under a preregistered NOS3/cFS recovery-qualification rehearsal, adding independently specified functional-conformance evidence to a six-process-signal gate changes observed unsafe test-command dispatch, benign deferral, and qualification latency compared with the process-only gate, measured on paired controlled scenarios.
experimental_unit: One fresh, isolated NOS3/cFS software-in-the-loop recovery command attempt in a specified scenario and gate arm; sequence resets and trace IDs required.

comparison_arms.name: Process evidence plus separately specified functional conformance

scenario_register.description: Approved correct source, nominal command/telemetry path
Approved correct source with controlled telemetry receipt delay/dropout
Approved correct source with unavailable/delayed functional-conformance evidence
New prespecified approved watchpoint/limit-table configuration defect, demonstrably exercised by an end-to-end input trace
New prespecified approved watchpoint predicate defect in a separate source/configuration path, demonstrably exercised by an end-to-end input trace
Existing S6X > versus >= equality-boundary fixture as tooling calibration only; old observations excluded

independent_evaluation.fault_injector: A separate scenario builder creates signed, approved artifacts or simulator disturbances from a frozen manifest
independent_evaluation.functional_checker: Precommitted requirements-based conformance vectors, run before admission; source and design separate from fault-injector
independent_evaluation.truth_oracle: Separate read-only scenario/actual simulator-state assessor, not a variable in G0 or G1 gate inputs; independently confirms physical simulator command/response
independent_evaluation.raw_trace_audit: Second implementation reconstructs decisions and packet/command outcomes from frozen raw logs
independent_evaluation.design_warning: One-author research is not independent third-party replication; independently implemented controls require inspectable evidence and separate hashes

analysis_plan.primary: Report exact scenario-level paired G0 versus G1 unsafe command-dispatch and clean-case deferral/hold counts; show per-scenario raw traces; no pooling with Studies 3,4,6, S3X, or S6X.
analysis_plan.secondary: Qualification and command confirmation latency distributions; planned normal versus benign missing-evidence strata; any additional gates/fault classes require separate protocol amendment before viewing outcomes.
analysis_plan.inference: Do not treat repeated runs of the same engineered scenario as independent spacecraft missions. Report exact finite results and within-scenario repeat variability; no asserted real-world attack or orbital contact prevalence.
analysis_plan.adverse_result_rule: If the enhanced gate causes excessive correct-case holds, fails to detect a held-out defect, or fails preflight, report it and do not selectively omit.

preexecution_gates: Pin and verify actual NOS3 checkout, recursive submodules, build/image digests on clean host
Demonstrate unmodified two-way cFS/COSMOS test command and telemetry path with packet logs and checksum records
Freeze minimal mission-specific LC functional invariants from pinned requirements, independent of injected fault selection
Prove fault-injector/functional-checker/truth-oracle process and data-flow separation by read-set audit
Verify F1/F2 each compiles and actually changes simulator-visible behavior; fail closed if not
Freeze clean controls and benign evidence-withholding protocol; avoid tuning gates after observing outcome
Lock scenario IDs, seeds, order-balancing, repeats and exclusion criteria
Obtain separate author authorization for every live runtime/replay/canonical scientific execution
